description: Search open vacancies for seafarers on Krew Guru by rank, vessel type and boarding date. Use this when a seafarer asks which jobs are open, for example "2/E jobs on bulk carriers joining in November" or "AB vacancies on tankers". Returns up to 20 published vacancies with a boarding date that has not passed, salary range in USD per month (net), contract length in months and a vacancy_url to open the vacancy on krew.guru. Company contacts are not returned; the seafarer applies on krew.guru. Do not use for checking whether a crewing agency or a job offer is genuine, for jobs ashore, or for a seafarer's own applications.

date_of_boarding.description: Planned joining date, YYYY-MM-DD. Matches vacancies boarding within one week of this date.

rank.description: Rank (position on board). Use the full name or a short code, for example: Master; Chief Officer (CO, C/O); Second Officer (2O, 2/O); Chief Engineer (CE, C/E); Second Engineer (2E, 2/E); Third Engineer (3E); ETO (Electro-Technical Officer); Bosun; AB (Able Seaman); OS (Ordinary Seaman); Motorman/Oiler; Chief Cook. Write 2/E as "2E" or "Second Engineer".

ship_type.description: Vessel type, for example: Bulk carrier, Container ship, Oil tanker, Product tanker, Chemical tanker, LNG carrier, LPG carrier, General cargo vessel, Car carrier, AHTS (anchor handling tug supply), PSV (Platform Supply Vessel), Cruise ship, Dredger. Groups are accepted too: oil, chem, gas, bulk, container, cargo, offshore.
